tools.description: POST /api/v2/tasks/{taskId}/execution-summaries. Explicit executionTracking optionally records start/checkpoint/pause/resume/finish atomically with this summary. Start before work, save returned IDs, query listOpenExecutionIntervals before recovery; pause/finish before switching tasks. evidenceIds select supplied usage observations; start declares counterMode and coverageRootSessionId. Never infer boundaries from status or timestamps. Conflicting source/root returns 409 with active interval IDs. Missing evidence requires a comment, not fabricated tokens. Task status changes require an execution summary, including close_activity using the same atomic service. statusObserved is a server-owned historical snapshot. Every new summary requires usageReport.entries with measured cumulative_snapshot session/session_tree usage, identified modelId and actor.kind=agent with persisted UUIDv7. Supply non-null decimal-string totalTokens equal to inclusive inputTokens + outputTokens; never add cached input or reasoning output again. The total is the source session/epoch/model/actor accumulation through observedAt, not task-exclusive consumption or a required delta. A first real snapshot is accepted as a baseline with previousEvidenceId null and delta null. Subsequent comparable snapshots reference the latest evidenceId; preserve reset/gap baselines honestly. Repeated evidence keeps its identity and is not counted twice. Keep multiple disjoint sessions/models separate; do not sum cumulative checkpoints or overlapping tree and child totals, or label mixed-model totals with the last selected model. Collect actual session counters from permitted Codex App Server/exec streams, Copilot SDK/CLI/VS Code telemetry, Claude SDK/OTel, or authorized Cursor usage exports; check surface/version and documented counter semantics. Kiro credits/context are not token measurements. No unavailable, estimated, model null, missing total or fabricated zero can substitute in a new summary. If collection fails, record the impediment in a comment without changing status or claiming a saved summary. Legacy reads, late-evidence schemas and exact saved idempotent replays remain compatible. Every new summary also requires commitReport: hasCommits=false with commits=[] or hasCommits=true with repositoryKey, explicit named/detached/unknown branch, full hash and availability per reference. Resolve repositories from task.workScope. Never fabricate a commit. Local/unknown commits have no remote link; published links require remoteVerifiedAt and explicit GitHub/GitLab webUrl matching the hash. Legacy omission is not false; exact saved replays remain valid. See beeteam://references/repository-evidence.. Actor is declared, not authenticated.
